messages:
alex: thinking about the autofallback UX — want to propose a compact policy editor that surfaces why a fallback happened (trigger, sampled inputs, cost delta) without blowing up the console.
meera: yes please. current audit view is too noisy, hard to find the signal :cry:
jonathan: can you sketch the compact fields you want?
alex: primary idea: 3-line summary + expand for details. summary shows: degrade_mode, trigger_type, last_trigger_ts, % of traffic diverted, and a one-line cost/latency delta.
lina: +1. we should also surface whether the fallback was automatic vs manual rollback. Important for incident reviews.
alex: agreed. thinking about two affordances: 1) quick glance (summary) 2) forensic panel (sampled requests + model outputs + eval metric). default to sampled = 10 per hour.
meera: on triggers — do we treat transient 500 spikes the same as quality regressions? UX needs to differentiate.
jonathan: backend already tags triggers with reason codes: runtime_error, latency_percentile, model_quality. UI can show distinct icons/colors. runtime_error -> orange, latency -> yellow, quality -> red.
alex: added thought: let teams set a "quiet degrade" mode where fallback happens for runtime/latency but doesn't create a high-severity incident. still audit-logged though.
product-ux: quiet degrade sounds useful, but we need to communicate risk. maybe a hover tooltip: "quiet = no oncall paging, still counted for SLA windows".
lina: also need a toggle in rollout config: "always audit" (write full request/response) vs "redact" (only metadata). compliance teams will want default redact.
meera: right. PII concerns. redact by default and let enterprise opt into full request capture with a policy justification.
jonathan: for the forensic panel, suggest this JSON snippet to render:

```
{
  "degrade_mode": "quiet",
  "trigger": "latency_p95",
  "threshold": "1200ms",
  "sampling": 10,
  "audit_capture": "redact"
}
```

alex: that's basically it. UX question: where to show the timeline? in rollout page (per-service) or model page (per-model)?
product-ux: rollout page is primary. model page can aggregate per-model fallbacks across rollouts.
meera: telemetry considerations: we need breadcrumbs tying fallback -> policy version -> cluster region -> kernel selection. otherwise root cause is hard to find.
lina: yeah include kernel/version in audit metadata. small extra storage but huge debugging win.
ops-bot: NOTE: fallback events will be emitted as `fallback.event.v1` with fields {policy_id, trigger_code, sample_id, region, model_version}.
alex: perfect. UX: add an inline "replay" button for sampled requests that opens a readonly sandbox with the request and both outputs (primary vs fallback) side-by-side.
jonathan: security note: replay must never run user-provided functions or calls. sandbox should be a deterministic renderer only.
product-ux: for the summary card copy: "Automatic fallback — quiet (latency_p95) — 8% traffic". Clicking expands forensic panel.
lina: can we add a small time-series sparkline on the card showing trigger count over last 1h? helps spot oscillations.
meera: yes and add an oscillation detector badge if there's >3 toggles in 10m.
alex: UX flow for manual override: button "force primary" with TTL, and audit reason required. must be in rollout RBAC scope.
product-ux: require a reason field and store it in audit trail. show reason in timeline.
jonathan: implementation: backend will accept an override API `POST /rollouts/{id}/override` with {until_ts, reason, actor} and will emit `override.event.v1`.
alex: OK next steps: product-ux to mockup compact summary + forensic panel. eng to add event fields (kernel/model_version/replay_safe_flag). meera to write privacy defaults and sampling policy. I'll create a Figma link and a short PRD.
product-ux: will prototype early tomorrow ; will include copy for quiet vs aggressive modes.
lina: I'll coordinate with security/compliance about redact defaults and retention TTLs.
meera: I'll draft telemetry schema and sampling knobs.
alex: thanks all. @jonathan mind adding the `replay_safe_flag` to the event contract?
jonathan: on it. pushing a first draft to the schema repo.
alex: :thumbsup: when we have mockups let's do a quick 30m sync.
product-ux: :eyes: available after 2pm PT.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — schema changes require migration plan. see https://redwood.internal/schemas#migrations
alex: noted. I'll include migration notes in the PR.
meera: one more UX nit — when a fallback is sampled, show a small privacy shield icon if the payload was redacted.
product-ux: good call, will add.
lina: also add a filter in the rollout timeline for "fallback events" so reviewers can jump to them.
alex: great. wrapping up — I'll open an RFC thread with the mockup link and policy proposals. thanks everyone.
ops-bot: rfc-bot: RFC created: "compact-fallback-audit-ux" — https://redwood.internal/rfcs/987
alex: nice, see you on the RFC thread.
